description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Axle Housing, Stud Bolts, Filler/Drain Plugs & Breather Cap.
This Part Houses all the Rear Drivetrain Parts.
Genuine Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Axle Housing
Qty 8 – Stud Bolts
Qty 1 – Breather Cap Assembly
Qty 1 – Filler Plug
Qty 1 – Drain Plug & Gasket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
